title: Balsam：多任務裝箱、長尾與集合工期
titleEn: Balsam: ensemble packing, long tails and makespan
subcategoryTitle: 科學工作流與資料契約
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「Balsam：多任務裝箱、長尾與集合工期」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩種四槽時間圖、總工作下界、任務身分與尾端診斷。
summaryEn: Investigate Balsam: ensemble packing, long tails and makespan using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver two four-slot timelines, a total-work lower bound, task identities and a tail diagnosis distinguishing scheduling effects from inaccurate workload estimates.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「資源槽與任務契約」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？

options: 長尾可能來自順序、任務時間估計失準或共享輸入瓶頸；本例不含 I/O 競爭，不能把八秒當實機預測。
長任務先在本例達到下界，但一般裝箱仍需實際資源形狀與公平性；驗收包含產物與無超額配置。
多任務科學集合的尾端常被少數長作業主導；即使總工作不變，合法任務順序也會改變整批完成時間。
optionsEn: A long tail may reflect ordering, inaccurate duration estimates or shared-input bottlenecks. This fixture excludes I/O contention, so eight seconds is not a real-system prediction.
Long-first attains the lower bound here, but general packing needs actual resource shapes and fairness constraints. Acceptance includes artifacts and absence of oversubscription.
A scientific ensemble can finish with a long tail dominated by a few tasks. Even with unchanged total work, feasible task ordering can alter the batch completion time.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。多任務科學集合的尾端常被少數長作業主導；即使總工作不變，合法任務順序也會改變整批完成時間。 與本階段判準一起判讀：同時最多四任務，不把 cores 數誤當任務槽數。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. A scientific ensemble can finish with a long tail dominated by a few tasks. Even with unchanged total work, feasible task ordering can alter the batch completion time. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: At most four tasks run concurrently; core count is not the number of task slots.

knowledge.textEn: Nominal: 4+8 = 12 seconds-makespan; changed: max(8,4+4) = 8 seconds-makespan. Move the two eight-second tasks to the front while preserving all resources and task durations. All numerical datasets and acceptance thresholds are teaching assumptions, not measured results from the named project. Preserve intermediate quantities so another investigator can reproduce the calculation without the original software installation.

quiz.question: 對「資源槽與任務契約」執行以下研究後，哪一項是直接驗收條件？明列四槽各八 cores，六任務皆一槽且不可中斷；記錄無依賴與零啟動成本的教學假設。
quiz.questionEn: After this investigation for Define slots and task requirements, which is the direct acceptance criterion? Specify four slots of eight cores each, with every task requiring one nonpreemptive slot. State the absence of dependencies and startup overhead, separating this packing model from a fully configured production launcher.
options: 排程推論取決於時長與獨立性；兩種擾動不可混為同因。
同時最多四任務，不把 cores 數誤當任務槽數。
基線十二秒完成，尾端有兩槽閒置。
optionsEn: Scheduling conclusions depend on duration and independence; the two perturbations represent different causes.
At most four tasks run concurrently; core count is not the number of task slots.
Baseline completion is twelve seconds, with two idle slots during the tail.
quiz.explanation: 同時最多四任務，不把 cores 數誤當任務槽數。
quiz.explanationEn: At most four tasks run concurrently; core count is not the number of task slots.

steps.title: 資源槽與任務契約 · 執行本階段研究
steps.titleEn: Define slots and task requirements · Carry out this investigation
steps.objective: 完成「資源槽與任務契約」的執行本階段研究，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete carry out this investigation for Define slots and task requirements and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
明列四槽各八 cores，六任務皆一槽且不可中斷；記錄無依賴與零啟動成本的教學假設。
逐項完成本階段動作，在結果表保留輸入、公式或狀態轉移、輸出及版本。將每個輸出對到以下判準，不能以「已做完」代替工程證據：同時最多四任務，不把 cores 數誤當任務槽數。
steps.instructionEn:
Specify four slots of eight cores each, with every task requiring one nonpreemptive slot. State the absence of dependencies and startup overhead, separating this packing model from a fully configured production launcher.
Carry out each action and retain inputs, formulas or state transitions, outputs, and revision. Map every output to the following criterion; completing an activity is not acceptance evidence: At most four tasks run concurrently; core count is not the number of task slots.
steps.observation: 原始紀錄支持本階段的結果，而非只有結論。同時最多四任務，不把 cores 數誤當任務槽數。
steps.observationEn: Raw records support the investigation outcome, not only a verdict. At most four tasks run concurrently; core count is not the number of task slots.
steps.failure: 省略中間資料，使驗收判據無法逐項重現。
steps.failureEn: Omitting intermediate records so that acceptance cannot be reproduced criterion by criterion.
steps.check: 同時最多四任務，不把 cores 數誤當任務槽數。
steps.checkEn: At most four tasks run concurrently; core count is not the number of task slots.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 多任務科學集合的尾端常被少數長作業主導；即使總工作不變，合法任務順序也會改變整批完成時間。
knowledge.textEn: A scientific ensemble can finish with a long tail dominated by a few tasks. Even with unchanged total work, feasible task ordering can alter the batch completion time.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 使用原創合成資料研究「Balsam：多任務裝箱、長尾與集合工期」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩種四槽時間圖、總工作下界、任務身分與尾端診斷。
knowledge.textEn: Investigate Balsam: ensemble packing, long tails and makespan using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver two four-slot timelines, a total-work lower bound, task identities and a tail diagnosis distinguishing scheduling effects from inaccurate workload estimates.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本例四個相同工作槽，每任務獨占一槽且不可搶占；總工作除槽數是下界，不保證任意順序都能達到。
knowledge.textEn: Use four identical slots with nonpreemptive tasks occupying one slot each. Total task work divided by slots is a lower bound, not a guarantee that arbitrary ordering attains it.

quiz.question: 「資源槽與任務契約」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Define slots and task requirements: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 逐槽畫時間線，核對每任務恰執行一次且槽數不超四；總工作三十二槽秒除四為八秒下界。
長尾可能來自順序、任務時間估計失準或共享輸入瓶頸；本例不含 I/O 競爭，不能把八秒當實機預測。
三十二 cores 分成四個八-core 槽；任務長度 [4,4,4,4,8,8] 秒，基線短任務先，變更長任務先。
optionsEn: Draw per-slot timelines and verify each task runs exactly once without exceeding four slots. Total work of thirty-two slot-seconds establishes an eight-second lower bound.
A long tail may reflect ordering, inaccurate duration estimates or shared-input bottlenecks. This fixture excludes I/O contention, so eight seconds is not a real-system prediction.
Partition thirty-two cores into four eight-core slots. Task durations are [4,4,4,4,8,8] seconds; compare short-first arrival order with a long-first order under identical outputs and resources.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。逐槽畫時間線，核對每任務恰執行一次且槽數不超四；總工作三十二槽秒除四為八秒下界。 與本階段判準一起判讀：同時最多四任務，不把 cores 數誤當任務槽數。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Draw per-slot timelines and verify each task runs exactly once without exceeding four slots. Total work of thirty-two slot-seconds establishes an eight-second lower bound. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: At most four tasks run concurrently; core count is not the number of task slots.

steps.instructionEn:
Draw per-slot timelines and verify each task runs exactly once without exceeding four slots. Total work of thirty-two slot-seconds establishes an eight-second lower bound.
Return to the investigation: Specify four slots of eight cores each, with every task requiring one nonpreemptive slot. State the absence of dependencies and startup overhead, separating this packing model from a fully configured production launcher.

steps.instruction:
長尾可能來自順序、任務時間估計失準或共享輸入瓶頸；本例不含 I/O 競爭，不能把八秒當實機預測。
